Aisha Khan: Quick announcement — People Ops is launching a 3-month pilot: Return Buddy Program for teammates coming back from 8+ week leaves. Goal: smoother ramp, fewer missed deps, and a friendly point of contact.
Aisha Khan: Pilot basics: one peer buddy for up to 4 weeks, 1x/week 30-min check-in, manager does a 30-min return sync in week 1. Buddies get a $200 honorarium.
Aisha Khan: Eligible: FT/PT Redwood payroll employees returning from parental, caregiver, or medical leave. Contractors can participate as buddies informally but are not eligible for the honorarium.
Marco Ruiz: Is the honorarium global?
Aisha Khan: Yes — payroll disburses where possible. If payroll rules prevent payment well offer a gift card or training credit and People Ops will coordinate.
Priya Shah: Any required training for buddies?
Aisha Khan: Short 20-min orientation doc and a checklist (ramp goals, key contacts, systems access) in the People Ops wiki.
hr-bot: Form RB-2026 submitted (auto): returning_employee=Priya Shah, expected_return=2026-08-16.
Aisha Khan: Sign-up / nominations via form: https://forms.redwood.ai/return-buddy (RB-2026). Managers can also nominate buddies.
Aisha Khan: Measurement: ramp survey at week 2 & week 6, PR-signal (first PR authored), and blocker count. Well share aggregated findings after the pilot.
Aisha Khan: Note: this program supplements existing leave policy; no change to entitlements. For phased returns or accommodations, talk to your manager + People Ops.
Marco Ruiz: Thanks! Im happy to be a buddy — put me down as backend infra.
Aisha Khan: Thanks Marco :raised_hands: — well include availability on the form. Pilot starts next Monday.
Aisha Khan: DM People Ops with questions or edge cases.
